{{Top|leg}}
'''"Keyn"''' was the term used to describe field agents in the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau's]] [[Internal Affairs/Legends|Internal Affairs]] branch. The name came from the [[keyn]] carnivore native to the [[Gontzol system/Legends|Gontzol system]]. Information gathered by keyns was given to the investigate staff known as "[[dirtbug]]s" to review.
